actions.action: Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early, so Friday Dec 11 pay may arrive by Wed Dec 9. If you need it, you can get a zero-interest advance of up to $500, repaid from your next deposit. During the system move, card payments work offline up to $250 each (raised from $100).
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 5 (customers who live paycheck to paycheck).
Actions: Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently, Zero-interest advance up to $500, up to 20,000 customers, Offline card limit during migration $100 -> $250.
Cost $1,000,000 of the $4M budget.
